Talia Benson: :mega: Launching today: **Internal Unit Economics Dashboard (v0)**

This is the new source-of-truth view for **blended cost of inference as $/1M output tokens** with drilldowns by **model / region / customer tier**.

**Where to find it**
- Console (internal): https://console.redwoodinference.com/internal/unit-economics
- Feature flag: `unit_econ_dashboard` (on by default for Finance + Product + Eng Platform; if you get a 403, see Access below)

**What’s in v0**
- KPI tiles: Blended $/1M output tokens, output tokens, total allocated cost (blended)
- Trends (daily) + comparison to prior period
- Drilldowns: model_family, model_variant, region, customer_tier (`self_serve`, `dedicated`, `private`, `enterprise`)
- “Explain” (beta): attributes week-over-week delta to model mix, region mix, cache hit-rate change, and runtime config/quant adoption where available
- Export: CSV for the current slice (top 1k rows)

**Data freshness & reconciliation expectations**
- Updates: daily partitions; target availability by **06:00 UTC** (see freshness badge in top-right)
- Backfill: last **90 days** available
- Billing tie-out: expected to reconcile within **±1.5%** at daily totals (region + tier) once late events settle

**Known limitations (please read before you panic :slightly_smiling_face:)**
- Late-arriving metering events: last 1–2 days can move; use the “Data status” banner and avoid drawing conclusions from yesterday’s slice if it’s marked “degraded”.
- Credits/discount impacts are *not* shown in the default view. Discount-sensitive slices are restricted.
- Quantization profile breakdown is partial (only where `quantization_profile` tag is present end-to-end).
- Cache “savings estimate” is directional; it’s based on modeled compute deltas and will be refined.
- Cardinality guardrails: some high-card combinations are rolled up to `other` to keep query latency sane.

**Docs**
- Canonical metric definition (ADR): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ARCH/ADR-0142+Blended+cost+per+1M+output+tokens
- Finance KPI guide: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/FIN/Unit+economics+KPI+guide
- Data quality SLOs + alerts: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Unit+econ+metrics+data+quality+SLO

**How to give feedback / report bugs**
- Quick feedback thread here is fine, but for trackable items:
  - Post in #unit-econ-help with a screenshot + the exact filters/time range
  - Or file a Linear issue under the epic **PM-482** (template: “Unit Econ Dashboard Bug”) and tag @Logan Wright / @Caleb Johnson
- If this is a data freshness / missing partition issue, tag @Aisha Bello (SLO/oncall routing) and include the “Data status” badge state.

**Access**
- If you need access to restricted views (discount-sensitive / account-adjacent slices), ping @Naomi Feldman with your use case + manager approval.

Huge thanks to Platform + Finance + Console folks who got us here. Weekly review cadence starts next week.

— Talia

RedwoodBot: :white_check_mark: Internal feature flag `unit_econ_dashboard` enabled for groups: finance, product, eng-platform

Marissa Cole: :tada: congrats all. also FYI the dashboard has a “Share link” button now (copies a URL with current filters). if it breaks, pls yell at me.

Rishi Malhotra: This is great. Quick clarification: when Finance looks at “blended” here, is it gross of discounts/credits or net?

Logan Wright: @Rishi Malhotra gross of discounts/credits in the default view (compute + allocated overhead, plus the cache hit effects via the modeled compute attribution). The restricted view includes net adjustments, but we’re keeping that gated + audited.

Laura Bennett: +1 to what Logan said. For weekly reporting, we’ll use the default (gross) blended metric, and separately track net in FP&A. This is a big step forward.

Allison Grant: For folks watching this operationally: alerts are wired for (1) freshness lag, (2) completeness drop, and (3) reconciliation variance spikes. If you see a banner and aren’t sure what it means, tag me or @Aisha Bello.

Aisha Bello: Oncall note: if the badge says “DEGRADED (late events)”, please avoid screenshotting it into leadership threads without context :)

Elliot Price: Docs note: if you spot naming inconsistencies (e.g. “output_tokens” vs “generated_tokens”), drop a comment on the ADR page. We tried to standardize in the semantic layer but there are a few legacy references.

Caleb Johnson: If anyone gets surprising numbers, please include the “reconciliation variance” panel value in your bug report. It helps us tell “real change” vs “still settling / mapping issue”.

Naomi Feldman: Re access: please don’t share exported CSVs from restricted slices in broad channels. If you’re unsure whether your export is sensitive, ask me first.

Marissa Cole: Also: if the dashboard is slow for a slice, hit “Copy query debug” in the overflow menu and paste into the Linear ticket. Thomas added a bunch of guardrails but we still want examples.

Talia Benson: Thanks all. We’ll do a 20-min walkthrough at the end of next week’s Eng/Product sync (invite coming). In the meantime, please keep feedback coming in #unit-econ-help.
